query: INSERT INTO metadata_undo_operations (id, user_id, session_id, manifestation_id, work_id, request_id, field_name, before_state, after_state, after_revision, expires_at) SELECT id, $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, field, before_state, after_state, revision, $6 FROM UNNEST($7::uuid[], $8::text[], $9::jsonb[], $10::jsonb[], $11::bigint[]) AS operation(id, field, before_state, after_state, revision)
